{{Top|leg}}
'''Audiofilament''' was a very sensitive form of listening technology used in certain models of [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. It was developed by the [[Chiang/Xi]] technology corporation many years before the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
